acquisition_policy: Collector stores source facts and timestamps only. No collector-authored bullish/bearish effect, confidence, or trading interpretation.

records.headline: Copper inventories diverge across LME, SHFE and COMEX as Chinese downstream consumption weakens
facts: LME copper stocks 244,025 metric tons versus about 400,000 in April
SHFE copper stocks about 69,300 metric tons versus more than 430,000 in March
COMEX stocks 717,314 short tons on August 3
Chinese downstream copper consumption reported weakening at higher prices

records.headline: LME gripped by flash squeeze as copper tensions boil over
facts: Cash premium reached $545 per metric ton during the squeeze
Live LME stocks had fallen to just over 103,000 metric tons
More than 38,000 metric tons were newly delivered into LME warehouses

records.headline: Copper cathode social inventory sees significant drawdown
facts: Mainstream-region copper inventory fell 19,700 metric tons week on week to 114,200 metric tons
SMM reported end-user purchasing remained insufficient

records.headline: US tariff threat upends copper surplus as prices test all-time peak
facts: US refined-copper imports were almost 885,000 metric tons in first-half 2026
Reuters reported limited supply outside the US, strong domestic Chinese demand, mine disruptions and an Indonesian smelter outage
